description_en: Queries the sensitive data statistics of tracing watermark audits
description_zh: 查询溯源审计的敏感数据统计
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-statistic --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

Only data within the last month can be queried. StartTime cannot be earlier than one month before the current time. The query fails if the value is out of the supported range.
This parameter is optional. Default value: one month before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

仅支持查询最近1个月内的数据，StartTime 不得早于当前时间的1个月前，超出支持范围时查询将失败。
本参数非必填，默认值为当前时间的1个月前
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

Only data within the last month can be queried. StartTime cannot be earlier than one month before the current time. The query fails if the value is out of the supported range.
This parameter is optional. Default value: the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

仅支持查询最近1个月内的数据，StartTime 不得早于当前时间的1个月前，超出支持范围时查询将失败。
本参数非必填，默认值为当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of data statistics. Valid values:
ip: IP address statistics.
host: domain name statistics.
sensitive_code: sensitive data type statistics.
api: sensitive data API statistics
parameters.help_zh:
数据统计类型。取值：
ip：表示IP地址统计。
host：域名统计。
sensitive_code：表示敏感数据类型统计。
api：表示敏感数据接口统计
parameters.name: statistic_type

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: The list of sensitive data statistics

SensitiveCode.description_en:
The sensitive data type.

You can call [DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html） to obtain the supported sensitive data types
SensitiveCode.description_zh:
敏感数据类型。

您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html）获取支持的敏感数据类型

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
